description: Department of Agrarian Development - The Agricultural Development Act, No. 46 of 2000 as Amended by the Agricultural Development (Amendment) Act, No. 46 of 2011
reasoning: This gazette notification deals exclusively with land-related administrative matters, specifically the determination and amendment of Agrarian Development Council Authorized Areas across multiple districts. It involves land jurisdiction, boundary changes, and administrative area designations for agricultural development purposes, without any government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
